about: RoadSim physics v2 (draft): the option values of the preset roadsim-physics-v2 (roadsim/options.py loads "preset" from this file) and, for every fitted number, the dev data it came from. Calibrated on dev only (VED dev cars, EPA dev vehicles of checks/epa_vehicles.json, D3 dev vehicles). The decision log is roadsim/CALIBRATION.md. Conventional and shared physics: calibration agent 1 (13 Nov 2026); hybrid, plug-in, BEV, HVAC and bus: calibration agent 2 (13 Nov 2026).
status: final: physics v2 frozen 13 Nov 2026 (agents 1 and 2), before any held-out result was computed

provenance.eng_family_adj: fitted: conventional gasoline maps only (diesel and the hybrid Atkinson map unchanged); minimises the weighted squared median FE error of D3 dev extended hot UDDS + HWFET phases (weight 2), EPA check dev conventional FTP + HWY and EPA dev pool FTP + HWY (weight 1); see CALIBRATION.md rung C3
provenance.tire_dyno_frac: fitted: D3 dev 20 F tests (UDDS hot start +6.0 -> +4.3 % FE, cold start) and EPA pool cold FTP (n 43, +2.0 -> +0.2 %); physically the whole tyre loss on the roll is the vehicle's own

thermal_params.oil_C_J_K_per_L: fitted: oil node capacity x2 so the oil follows the D3 dev dipstick at -7 C (UDDS cold start, CX9/Accord/Camry: 62/56/53 C sim vs 64/49/60 C measured at 1300 s; B2 values gave 71/70/60)
thermal_params.oil_fric_scale: fitted: keeps the 24 C cold-start penalty after the slower oil (D3 dev extended UDDS cold start vs hot start at test-cell temperature: +0.1 vs +0.9 % FE)
thermal_params.cop_eta_belt: fitted: belt A/C COP / Carnot 0.33 -> 0.25: D3 dev Accord LX SC03 fuel with A/C auto vs off x1.28 sim vs x1.29 measured (x1.21 at 0.33); D3 SC03 AUTO phases +0.3 %, EPA pool SC03 -0.7 % (n 47), check-dev Sonata SC03 +3.9 %
thermal_params.cabin_UA_body_frac: calibration agent 2, 13 Nov 2026 (CALIBRATION.md rung H7): 0.6 -> 0.3 (conduction 36 W/K for a car). D3 dev -7 C tests: cabin at the end of each phase 5-9 K too cold (CX9, Accord LX, Camry) -> 4-5 K; CX9 cold-start UDDS coolant at 1200 s 55 -> 66 C (measured 74); Prius Prime logged heat-pump power +151 -> +43 % (HWFET), Leaf ePlus +30/+49 -> -2 %; SC03 conventional -1.2 points
thermal_params.cop_eta_el: calibration agent 2, 13 Nov 2026 (CALIBRATION.md rung H7b): 0.36 -> 0.50: D3 dev hot tests, logged electric A/C energy sim/measured 1.38 -> 1.06 (Prius Prime) and 1.38 -> 1.17 (Leaf ePlus)
thermal_params.door_cd: calibration agent 2, 13 Nov 2026 (CALIBRATION.md rung H9): bus door exchange 0.6 -> 0.2 with door_min_ms 0.15 -> 0.03 and bus fresh-air flow 2.2 -> 0.8 kg/s: 40 ft BEV bus CBD14 10-32 C 2.10 -> 1.83 kWh/mi (Foothill 1.82-2.15), heating at 7.5 C ~9 kW (ZTBus dev 18 m bus: ~4.5 kW above the 15-20 C standstill base); the PTC loop still saturates at stops (controller, not fixed)
thermal_params.air_kg_s_max: bus 2.2 -> 0.8 kg/s with door_cd (H9); light-duty unchanged (fresh-air flow 0.6x made the D3 cabins colder: rejected)

provenance.substeps: rejected as default: B3 measured <= 0.1 % trip energy change (0.8 % worst P2) at 10x run time; use substeps=10 for drivability / OBD-like signals
provenance.tyre_model: decided: +0.5 % fuel on VED dev conventional twins (slip losses), costs 8 % run time (conventional, 1 Hz) / 2 % (hybrid); kept for the physics (regen and traction limits for agent 2)
provenance.wind_z0_site_m: decided: EN 1991-1-4 terrain category III (suburban Ann Arbor roads) instead of 0.1; VED dev conventional twins: error spread calm vs windy trips 5.2 -> 4.7 points (B3 log profile already removed most of v1's windy-day bias)
provenance.wind_gusts: rejected for the default: no change on VED dev twins (-9.05 vs -9.05 % median), adds a random realisation; stays an option
provenance.drafting: no gap data in any dev set; stays an option
provenance.aux_base_W: measured: median alternator output of the D3 dev extended-era conventional cars on hot std-temperature UDDS/HWFET/US06 tests, HVAC off (CX9 262, Accord LX 246, Camry XLE 243, Blazer 202 W; 108 tests)
provenance.conv_tc_open_gears: measured: D3 dev Camry XLE (8AT) and CX9 (6AT) engine minus turbine speed on hot UDDS/HWFET/US06: 1st gear always open (400-740 rpm slip), 2nd mostly open (40-310 rpm; CX9 130-166 rpm, locked < 10 % of the time)
provenance.conv_tc_slip_rpm: measured: same D3 data, locked gears 3 to top-1 run 15-70 rpm controlled slip under drive (Camry 20-50, CX9 15-70 rpm); top gear ~0-15 rpm
provenance.eng_transient_fuel: fitted with eng_family_adj (same objective); D3 dev metered fuel shows accelerations under-fuelled and steady cruise over-fuelled at equal load; 0.5 s balances D3 US06 (+7.6 % FE) and EPA pool US06 (-1.4 %)
provenance.onroad_aux_W: conv 700 W: calibration agent 1 (rung C6). Electrified, calibration agent 2, 13 Nov 2026 (CALIBRATION.md rung H6): hev 1250 W fitted on the VED dev Toyota twins (car median -13.4 -> +0.7 % at 45 km/h; 1000 W -5.5, 1300 W +0.7; no other VED dev hybrid has a usable label: CR-Z twins excluded), applied to every HEV type for want of data; bev and phev 300 W fitted on the VED dev Leaf (car median -8.0 -> -0.1 %); the Volt and Energi twins give -10 / -12 % with it
provenance.regen_share: calibration agent 2, 13 Nov 2026 (CALIBRATION.md rung H2): D3 dev 2021 Sonata Hybrid regen capture (battery charge in braking / negative wheel energy, hot std UDDS/HWFET/US06): 0.53/0.50/0.55 measured vs 0.70/0.57/0.69 simulated; 0.75 for P2 only. D3 Sonata UDDS fuel_corr -20.0 -> -9.2 %, EPA check-dev Sonata Hybrid FTP +15.5 -> +4.3 % FE (HWY -3.9 -> -5.9, US06 -5.2 -> -9.5). Power-split, series and plug-in regen matched the measurement within 0.1 and are left at 1
provenance.series_dd_rpm_per_kph: calibration agent 2, 13 Nov 2026 (CALIBRATION.md rung H3): measured on D3 dev 2015 Accord Hybrid: engine rpm / road speed at lock-up 22.7 rpm per km/h (mode of all UDDS/HWFET/US06 seconds; 79-80 % of engine-on seconds at 70-100 km/h sit within 0.6 of it)
provenance.series_dd_v_min_kph: calibration agent 2, 13 Nov 2026 (CALIBRATION.md rung H3): same data: lock-up share 0.02 at 40-60, 0.23 at 60-70, 0.79 at 70-80 km/h
provenance.series_dd_prefer: calibration agent 2, 13 Nov 2026 (CALIBRATION.md rung H3): a running engine drives through the clutch inside the window (i-MMD engine drive at cruise); D3 Accord HWFET +4.5 -> +1.9 % fuel, engine-on gap -16 -> -11 points; EPA check-dev Accord HWY -5.5 -> -4.6 % FE
provenance.ps_engine_on_kph: calibration agent 2, 13 Nov 2026 (CALIBRATION.md rung H5): VED dev Toyota twins (VED_241, 258, 375): engine-on share gap -24 -> -11.6 points at 45 km/h (55: -18); EPA check-dev RAV4 FTP +7.9 -> +5.5, Escape +3.9 -> +1.7 % FE; D3 dev 2010 Prius UDDS engine-on +4 -> +9 points (legacy data)
provenance.phev_engine_heat: calibration agent 2, 13 Nov 2026 (CALIBRATION.md rung H4): D3 dev plug-ins at -7 C in charge sustaining: a PTC-only cabin made the engine recharge the battery for the heater (Volt CS UDDS fuel +45-50 %, Energi +54-64 %); with the heater core on the engine loop: Volt -0.1 to -11 %, Energi +4 to +16 %
provenance.phev_heat_engine_below_C: calibration agent 2, 13 Nov 2026 (CALIBRATION.md rung H4): Volt-type engine-assisted heating below -10 C; D3 dev Prius Prime -18 C cold-start CD 8xUDDS +1 % energy (engine-on 0.54 vs 0.70); a 0 C threshold made Volt/Prime -7 C tests +36-62 % (rejected)
provenance.hybrid_chg_cap_frac: calibration agent 2, 13 Nov 2026 (CALIBRATION.md rung H2b): rejected (None). Capping engine charging at 5-10 % of engine power moved D3 Sonata UDDS -20 -> -14/-19 % but HWFET +2.6 -> +12/+6 %
provenance.phev_heat_cold_start_only: calibration agent 2, 13 Nov 2026 (CALIBRATION.md rung H4): rejected (False). Engine heat after cold starts only fixed the Energi cold-start tests (-45/-36 -> -3/+10 %) but put the Volt and Prius Prime 8xUDDS cold starts at +62 / +36 %
provenance.eng_fullload_enrich: calibration agent 2, 13 Nov 2026 (CALIBRATION.md rung H8): rejected (0). 10-20 % extra fuel above 85 % of full torque moved D3 dev extended US06 only -6.3 -> -6.0 %; from 60 % torque -6.3 -> -4.2 % but the EPA dev pool US06 already burns 2.9 % too much (opposite sign): left at 0

dev_data.VED: realdata.load_trips("dev") cars of data/proc/splits.json; label matched twins (checks/check_ved_twin.py)
dev_data.EPA: checks/epa_vehicles.json split dev + checks/epa_dev_pool.json (RoadData dev families, held-out families excluded)
dev_data.D3: data/proc/d3/splits.json dev vehicles: 2016 Mazda CX9, 2018 Honda Accord LX, 2018 Toyota Camry XLE, 2019 Chevrolet Blazer (metered, weighted most); legacy-era conventional cars (modal fuel) shapes only; electrified dev: 2021 Sonata Hybrid (metered), 2015 Accord Hybrid, 2010 Prius / Fusion Hybrid / Insight / S400h (legacy, fuel weighted low), 2013 C-Max and Fusion Energi, 2016 Volt, 2017 Prius Prime, Leafs, Bolt, Ioniq5, i-MiEV, Soul EV, e-Golf
dev_data.ZTBus: realdata.ztbus_full("dev") standstill power (bus HVAC compared, rung H9)
